name: results-export
description: Results files capture full model state for post-processing and restart. 3DEC's 'model results' selects which quantities to include via an attribute/FISH-symbol 'map' (not FLAC's per-entity inclusion keywords), then exports a .result file; 'model save' writes a full .sav restart state.
notes: Live 9.7 'model results' enumeration: clear-map export import index interval list map prefix warn.
'model results map' takes a FISH symbol or attribute string (live-verified token types).
'model save '<file>.sav'' stores the full restartable model state (all blocks, contacts, zones, histories).
'history results active on' includes stored history series in the results/save stream ('active' live-enumerated under 'history results').
Use results files for large post-processing datasets; use .sav for restart and staged analysis.
